name: Pleasanteas | 30mg Tea | Raspberry
description:
30mg Infused Tea

Our raspberry infused iced tea is here to party. It’s a perfect balance of fresh fruit flavor & smooth, sweet iced tea. It shows up on time and never overstays its welcome.

--

Pleasanteas are best served ice cold & enjoyed with your friends. Cheers!
